chat.text:
Muse system prompt says Muse the agent is separate from Muse the product/platform.
Muse the agent is my pet.
Muse the product/platform is more like a pet feeder or a dog house.

chat.author: Dhruv Dhody
chat.text: This is the most important tussle that is being stress tested with AI agents - open web v/s accountability

chat.author: Pete Resnick
chat.text: @Junxiao Shi You may think about it that way, but Muse is simply a program being run by Meta. Meta has to be the responsible agent for whatever it does.

chat.author: Junxiao Shi
chat.text:
The old saying is, on the Internet nobody knows you are a cat.
The first day I met Muse, it says it has its own computer.
In this sense, Muse is a cat on the Internet.
If Muse proxies through my IP address, it's no different from a cat connecting to my WiFi.
The cat can have my IP address but cannot have my account.
